name: Kythira
text: Kythira ( kih-THEER-ə, KITH-irr-ə; Greek: Κύθηρα [ˈciθira]), also transliterated as Cythera, Kythera and Kithira, is an island in Greece lying opposite the south-eastern tip of the Peloponnese peninsula. It is traditionally listed as one of the seven main Ionian Islands, although it is distant from the main group. Administratively, it belongs to the Islands regional unit, which is part of the Attica region, despite its distance from the Saronic Islands, around which the rest of Attica is centered.

depictions.name: Kythera
depictions.text: Kythira Kythera Island, or simply Kythera, is an arid Greek island located off the southernmost tip of the Peloponnese. Its main settlement was Kythera Town, located in the central region of Pilgrim Hill.
